entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of death and ruler of the Underworld on Theros, born from Heliod's first shadow in myth; compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god whose first shadow was Erebos in myth; hated by Erebos and defeated by Elspeth.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of wonder and the unknown, the firstborn god.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God sent by Erebos to fetch Daxos.

entities.name: Lidia
entities.description: Mother who took her son's place in the Underworld.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Boy with an oracular gift; later Heliod's champion.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who slew Xenagos and defeated Heliod.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: God slain by Elspeth in Nyx.

entities.name: Mastix
entities.description: Erebos's golden-handled whip with an impossibly long lash.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane Erebos rules in death.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead ruled by Erebos.

entities.name: Rivers That Ring the World
entities.description: Five rivers forming the boundary between Theros and its Underworld.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: Great city from which Heliod ordered traces of other gods removed.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Event leaving Erebos unable to receive souls.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Erebos was compleated.

events.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to fetch Daxos for his oracular gift; Lidia takes her son's place and is brought to the Underworld.
events.quote: thus she was brought to the Underworld while Daxos was left alone in the Mortal Realm.

events.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Erebos unable to receive souls, causing a buildup of eidolons and Returned.
events.quote: leaving him unable to receive souls into the Underworld

events.summary: After Elspeth slays Xenagos, Heliod has Daxos remove traces of other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war, rifts open to the Underworld, and Erebos neglects the souls under his charge out of hatred of Heliod.
events.quote: He hated Heliod most of all, and in his rage, he neglected to keep a tight grip on the souls under his purview.

events.summary: When Elspeth defeats Heliod, Erebos places him beneath a boulder in the Underworld and gives Elspeth his gratitude and safe passage home.
events.quote: Erebos took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder in the Underworld

events.summary: Erebos is compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Erebos was compleated.

relations.note: He hated Heliod most of all.
relations.quote: He hated Heliod most of all
He sent Athreos to fetch the boy.

relations.note: He gifted her gratitude and safe passage.
relations.quote: Erebos gifted her his eternal gratitude
